titulo_es.@es: hablar de capacidades pasadas, logros y capacidades futuras
titulo_es.@en: talk about past capacities, achievements and future capacities

texto.@es: Usa **can + verbo base** para una capacidad presente y **could + verbo base** para una capacidad general pasada: **As a child, Amir could swim well.** Para un logro concreto y completado en una ocasión pasada, normalmente se usa **was/were able to** o **managed to**: **He was able to walk again after treatment.**
texto.@en: Use **can + verbo base** for a present capacity and **could + verbo base** for a passed overall capacity: **As a child, Amir could swim well.** for a concrete and completed achievement on a past occasion, it is usually used **was/were able to** or **managed to**: **He was able to walk again after treatment.**

titulo.@es: Otras formas de be able to

texto.@es: **Be able to + verbo base** permite expresar capacidad en tiempos en los que no se puede usar **can**, por ejemplo **will be able to** para el futuro. En una frase negativa pasada, son posibles **couldn't** y **wasn't/weren't able to**.
texto.@en: **Be able to + verbo base** allows to express capacity in times when **can** cannot be used, for example **will be able to** for the future. In a past negative phrase, **couldn't** and **wasn't/weren't able to** are possible.
